platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.subtitle: Adapters and connections
platforms.intro: Choose the NoneBot adapter modules to load and review active Bot connections. Install adapter packages and configure their credentials separately.
platforms.modulesLabel: Python module paths (one per line or comma-separated)
platforms.modulesHint: Default: nonebot.adapters.onebot.v11. Changes take effect after restart. An empty list disables all Bot adapters. This field does not install modules or accept credentials.
platforms.processOverride: A process environment variable overrides the module list in .env. The saved value takes effect after removing that override.
platforms.modulesSaved: Adapter modules saved; restart to apply
platforms.onebotConfigHint: Multiple forward WebSocket URLs are supported. The access token is never returned; leave it blank to keep the current value.
platforms.onebotSaved: OneBot settings saved; restart to apply
platforms.noOnebotNeeded: OneBot V11 is not enabled. NapCat link checks do not apply; Stella can still use other configured adapters or WebChat.
platforms.onebotNotReady: The OneBot V11 link is not ready. Check that the adapter is enabled and that NapCat's WebSocket address matches this service.
platforms.noConnections: There are no connected Bot instances.
platforms.host: Listen address (reverse mode; use 0.0.0.0 for a remote adapter)
platforms.wsUrlsHint: Use one ws:// or wss:// URL per line or comma-separated; leave blank for reverse WS.
platforms.accessTokenHint: Must match the adapter-side value; blank leaves the current token unchanged.
platforms.restartHint: Saved to the local .env file. Restart to apply.
